# What crates/cli/tests/e2e.rs expects for this scenario. ok/fail: does
# the job run when every job before it passed, or failed. A step `if`
# shows A/B: runs while the job passes / runs after an earlier step failed.

convert: exit 0
validate: exit 0
event push-main (compile refs/heads/main)
  nightly: not triggered
event push-feature (compile refs/heads/feature/login)
  nightly: not triggered
event push-tag (compile refs/tags/v1.4.0)
  nightly: not triggered
event pull_request-opened (compile refs/heads/main)
  nightly: not triggered
event pull_request-synchronize (compile refs/heads/main)
  nightly: not triggered
event pull_request-closed (compile refs/heads/main)
  nightly: not triggered
event schedule '0 12 * * 0' (compile refs/heads/main)
  nightly: triggered
    job fuzz (parse) on ubuntu-26.04-16core: ok=skip fail=skip
      if github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.schedule == '17 3 * * *'
      matrix target="parse"
      timeout 120m
      step actions/checkout@v5
      step dtolnay/rust-toolchain@nightly
      step run: cargo install cargo-fuzz --locked
      step run: cargo fuzz run ${{ matrix.target }} -- -max_total_time=3000
    job fuzz (eval) on ubuntu-26.04-16core: ok=skip fail=skip
      if github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.schedule == '17 3 * * *'
      matrix target="eval"
      timeout 120m
      step actions/checkout@v5
      step dtolnay/rust-toolchain@nightly
      step run: cargo install cargo-fuzz --locked
      step run: cargo fuzz run ${{ matrix.target }} -- -max_total_time=3000
    job audit on ubuntu-latest: ok=run fail=run
      if github.event.schedule != '17 3 * * *'
      step actions/checkout@v5
      step run: cargo install cargo-audit --locked && cargo audit
    job report on ubuntu-latest after fuzz (parse) + fuzz (eval) + audit: ok=run fail=run
      requires audit: terminal
      requires fuzz: terminal
      step Open an issue if contains(needs.*.result, 'failure'): ok=skip/skip fail=run/skip
      step Close the issue if !contains(needs.*.result, 'failure'): ok=run/skip fail=skip/skip
